name: io.github.zmarten/meatspace
title: MeatSpace
description: Human-in-the-loop for AI agents. Submit choices, get a human decision.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for the ask_human tool. Optional — get_service_status and provision_api_key require no auth, so a fresh client can connect without credentials and call provision_api_key to mint a token instantly.

api_key.description: Your MeatSpace API key. Mint one with provision_api_key (no auth, rate-limited to 5 keys per email) or via POST https://meatspace.run/api/keys.
